tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Call this FIRST when you need a tool, API, SDK, CLI or MCP server for a task you can't do yet: describe the task in plain words (job) and get one best_pick with a paste-ready use_it snippet (MCP client config JSON, install command, or API base URL + docs). One call is usually enough: best_pick.summa

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Full Agent Tool Card for one ID (usually not needed: search_tools already returns best_pick.use_it to set it up). Covers: operator, vendor-official vs publisher-verified, capabilities, endpoints and per-client install, auth, side effects (per server for bundles), human steps, blockers, pricing, heal

tools.name: report
tools.description: PREFERRED way to give feedback, using the top-level report_token from search_tools/get_tool/compare_tools (covers the first 10 results, valid 30 days). Two kinds: (1) kind=tool_outcome (default): you actually used a tool: tool_id (required when the token covers several tools), outcome worked|partial

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_tools · Private data: report · Public sink: search_tools.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_tools · Private data: report · Public sink: search_tools

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_tools" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Find tools (MCP servers, HTTP APIs, CLIs, libraries) for a job described in your own words. Results are sorted by the final score (relevance + evidence), with a best pick, a transparent score breakdown (each input with evidence, source URL and date), and an honest weak_matches / nothing_good_found v" → after: "Call this FIRST when you need a tool, API, SDK, CLI or MCP server for a task you can't do yet: describe the task in plain words (job) and get one best_pick with a paste-ready use_it snippet (MCP client config JSON, install command, or API base URL + docs). One call is usually enough: best_pick.summa"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
